findings.claim: The SafeItem fixtures (deployedSafe, cfSafe) and chain configs (chainWithSwap, chainWithoutSwap) are hand-written with fixed addresses instead of using the existing safeItemBuilder() and chainBuilder() test builders, which would fix only the fields under test and randomise the rest.

initialReduxState is typed with `as never`, which switches off type checking of the store shape and could hide drift in the safeActionsModal and undeployedSafes state, since the cfState helper builds an untyped object; it should instead be typed as Partial<RootState> with a real UndeployedSafe shape or a small typed helper.

router.replace(AppRoutes.welcome.spaces) runs inside a useEffect without being awaited or caught, so a rejected navigation would surface as an unhandled rejection; it should be fixed with a .catch(() => {}) or an awaited IIFE with try/catch.

Three visible behaviour changes (redirect to /welcome/spaces instead of staying on UnauthorizedState, undeployed Safes disabled for swap with new tooltip copy, and a new empty-state message when no wallet is connected) are not tied to a named product/design decision in the PR description; the ticket or design should be linked.
UnauthorizedState still renders briefly until the redirect finishes, and it should be confirmed whether this brief flash is intended.
The nested ternary inside the JSX is hard to read and would be clearer as a named value (e.g. an emptyMessage variable) computed before the return statement.
